asakura_mio.notes: 19, precise and restrained, worn down by the loop: a calm, low young woman rather than a bright anime heroine. Inner monologue is softer than speech.

voice.notes: Generic role for every "…聲音" speaker. In chapter 1 it is the dream voice that sounds neither male nor female.

asakura_yuma.notes: 15, quiet and sharp, speaks in very short sentences: a calm boy-to-young-man voice. Recast from Minto on 2026-10-29 because Minto sounded too mature; Hapadona picked Toru from three auditions.

police_officer.notes: Generic role for every unnamed police officer. Polite keigo and a flat, procedural tone: the desk officer who is courteous and closes every door.

kusakube_satoru.voiceName: 谷口 - 落ち着いたハスキーな低音
kusakube_satoru.notes: About 45, Mio's late father's old partner: a low, husky, tired voice with few words. Gruff protector who cannot explain himself.

shiraishi_kotone.notes: 19, Mio's best friend since freshman year: a mid-range, slightly husky, warm and approachable voice, the relatable best friend. Short, practical lines that mix care with a little bossiness. Picked by Hapadona from three auditions (Casual & Friendly, Konomi, Momoka) on 2026-10-30.

clinic_staff.notes: Generic role for every research-center front-desk staff member. Twenties to thirties, polite keigo, brisk but soft and warm: the receptionist whose smile never changes temperature. Picked from the library without audition.
